At the end of the summer holidays and the start of the school year, besides coaching and training we also managed exhibitions. The first was at a cycling race in Rasochy, where a group of local bikers gathered for a traditional race around the area. Vlasta and Lukáš Valný coped with the uneven terrain and made full use of the space provided, to the organisers' satisfaction.


On the first Saturday of September Vlasta and Mára Tryner headed to nearby Měšice for the local festival, where we were the opening act for Kapitán DEMO and a few other bands and effectively closed an afternoon full of exhibitions and performances.


At the same time Martin Šimůnek and Matouš Balík went wild in Lubné near Polička, despite a small complication – they couldn't use their exhibition trailer. Luckily the obstacles are portable, so everything was sorted to the organiser's satisfaction. Both teams also had a bit of luck, because the weather wasn't ideal that day, but everything dried out nicely for the exhibitions. In the meantime Martin Šimůnek also managed several exhibitions and workshops 'around the house', as they say.


In the coming weeks we're in for a bit of a grind and some more big events. On top of that comes the repair of the trail we helped build in Říčany.
